name: Euchre
tagline: Order it up, make trumps with your partner, and watch out for the bowers.
rulesSummary: Partners sit across. Five cards each from a 24-card deck (9 to A); the next card is turned up.

Going round, each player may order up the turned card as trumps (the dealer picks it up and discards) or pass. If all pass, anyone may name another suit; the dealer is stuck and must name one if it gets back to them.
Trumps rank: jack of trumps (right bower), the other jack of the same colour (left bower — it counts as a trump), then A K Q 10 9.
Makers need 3 tricks: 1 point, all 5: 2 points, alone and all 5: 4. Fail and the other team scores 2 (euchred). First to 10.
